hero.eyebrow: A PERSONAL FIELD GUIDE · YOHANNES BELAI
hero.title: See what others
hero.description: An exploration of human behavior, strategic thinking, emotional discipline, and the quiet advantages of seeing things as they are.
hero.mantra: Observe carefully. Think independently. Act deliberately.

philosophy.title: Perception
philosophy.text: Look beyond appearances. Examine incentives, context, repeated behavior, and the forces shaping decisions.

philosophy.title: Self-mastery
philosophy.text: Your reactions are yours to govern. Emotional discipline creates the space between what happens and what you choose to do.

philosophy.title: Strategic independence
philosophy.text: Build skills, relationships, resources, and alternatives before circumstances force your hand.

philosophy.title: Deliberate action
philosophy.text: Not every disagreement requires a response. Not every opportunity deserves pursuit. Learn to distinguish movement from progress.

behavior.title: Incentives
behavior.question: What rewards a decision?
behavior.text: Look at what a situation encourages: security, approval, convenience, or something less obvious. An incentive is a clue, not a verdict.

behavior.title: Pressure
behavior.question: What changes under strain?
behavior.text: Constraints can change how someone behaves. Understand the circumstances before deciding what a difficult moment means.

behavior.title: Patterns
behavior.question: What repeats over time?
behavior.text: Repeated choices offer more evidence than a single promise or mistake. Stay willing to revise your interpretation.

behavior.title: Priorities
behavior.question: What receives consistent care?
behavior.text: Notice where attention, time, and effort go. What someone protects can reveal what matters to them.

response.title: Observe
response.text: Separate what happened from the story you tell about it.

response.title: Interpret
response.text: Consider context and more than one plausible explanation.

response.title: Evaluate
response.text: Weigh your values, the consequences, and what needs attention.

response.title: Respond
response.text: Choose an action you can stand behind. Sometimes that means waiting.
response.prompt: What is a useful next step?

independence.title: Capability
independence.text: Develop skills that remain useful across changing circumstances.

independence.title: Resilience
independence.text: Build resources that help you withstand uncertainty.

independence.title: Relationships
independence.text: Invest in mutual trust before you need a favor.

independence.title: Optionality
independence.text: Create alternatives so a single outcome does not control your future.

about.title: A work in progress.
about.opening: I’m Yohannes. Still learning to see clearly.
about.bio: I’m an Ethiopian-American Computer Science student at Towson, based in Maryland. I like building software, playing pickup, and conversations that go somewhere. My Orthodox Christian faith keeps me grounded.
about.purpose: This is a place for ideas worth examining, patterns worth questioning, and principles I’m learning to put into practice. The aim is simple: understand more, react less, and make better decisions.
